claims.claim: 开头手在缝纫机压脚处引导蓝布。
标题卡之后双手捏住布边并折叠它。
折边时手拿出金属别针并穿过布料固定。

checks.evidence: Video 0.0-3.5s shows hands guiding blue fabric under the sewing machine presser foot.
After the title card (4.0-7.5s), Video 8.0-12.5s shows both hands pinching and folding the edge of the blue fabric.
During the folding action in Video 8.0-12.5s, no metal pins are visible being taken out or inserted into the fabric; only hand movements for folding are shown.
